1.text: Tha vision of Obadiah. like dis says tha Lord GOD concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from tha LORD, N an ambassador is sent among tha heathen, Arise y’all, N let us rise up against her in battle.
Look, I have made u small among tha heathen: u r greatly despised.
Tha pride of thine heart has deceived u, u dat dwell in tha clefts of tha rock, whose habitation is high; dat says in his heart, Who shall bring me down 2 tha ground?
Though u exalt urself as tha eagle, N though u set ur nest among tha stars, thence will I bring u down, says tha LORD.
If thieves came 2 u, if robbers by night, (how r u cut off!) would dey not have stolen till dey had enough? if tha grapegatherers came 2 u, would dey not leave some grapes?
How r tha things of Esau searched out! how r his hidden things sought up!

All tha men of ur confederacy have brought u even 2 tha border: tha men dat were at peace wit u have deceived u, N prevailed against u; dey dat eat ur bread have laid a wound under u: there is none understanding in him.
Shall I not in dat day, says tha LORD, even destroy tha wise men out of Edom, N understanding out of tha mount of Esau?
N ur mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, 2 tha end dat every one of tha mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.
4 ur violence against ur brother Jacob shame shall cover u, N u will be cut off 4 ever.
In tha day dat u stoodest on tha other side, in tha day dat tha strangers carried away captive his forces, N foreigners entered in2 his gates, N cast lots upon Jerusalem, even u were as one of ’em.

But u should not have looked on tha day of ur brother in tha day dat he became a stranger; neither should u have rejoiced over tha children of Judah in tha day of their destruction; neither should u have spoken proudly in tha day of distress.

u should not have entered in2 tha gate of my people in tha day of their calamity; yeah, u should not have looked on their affliction in tha day of their calamity, nor have laid hands on their substance in tha day of their calamity;
Neither should u have stood in tha crossway, 2 cut off dose of his dat did escape; neither should u have delivered up dose of his dat did remain in tha day of distress.
4 tha day of tha LORD is near upon all tha heathen: as u have done, it shall be done 2 u: ur reward shall return upon ur own head.
4 as y’all have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all tha heathen drink continually, yeah, dey shall drink, N dey shall swallow down, N dey shall be as though dey had not been.
But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, N there shall be holiness; N tha house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.

N tha house of Jacob shall be a fire, N tha house of Joseph a flame, N tha house of Esau 4 stubble, N dey shall kindle in ’em, N devour ’em; N there shall not be any remaining of tha house of Esau; 4 tha LORD has spoken it.
N dey of tha south shall possess tha mount of Esau; N dey of tha plain tha Philistines: N dey shall possess tha fields of Ephraim, N tha fields of Samaria: N Benjamin shall possess Gilead.
N tha captivity of dis host of tha children of Israel shall possess dat of tha Canaanites, even 2 Zarephath; N tha captivity of Jerusalem, which is in Sepharad, shall possess tha citiez of tha south.
N saviours shall come up on mount Zion 2 judge tha mount of Esau; N tha kingdom shall be tha LORD’s.
